summary: Microsoft Entra ID SSO implementation correctly addresses all 9 design findings. Finding #1 (csrf import from app) ✓, #2 (index verification script) ✓, #3 (redirect URI in config) ✓, #4 (func.now() for DB timestamps) ✓, #5 (explicit False checks) ✓, #6 (IntegrityError handling) ✓, #7 (case-insensitive username) ✓, #8 (configurable rate limits) ✓, #9 (IP fallback) ✓. Routes match specification: /auth/microsoft (initiate) and /auth/Microsoft/callback (capital M). Login template shows 'TR Portal Login' per user request. Production validation comprehensive. One minor note: datetime.utcnow() used in log_auth_attempt() is correct for Python-side log timestamps, not a func.now() violation since logs don't need database-side generation. Implementation is production-ready.
